entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mm, that was delicious.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The food was arranged on my plate[n]as though it were paint on a canvas.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The staff brought out this table and food[n]just for us, huh?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I thought if we were going to dine[n]together, it would be better to do it[n]somewhere with a view.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The VIP life is incredible!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Not that I'd expect anything else from[n]a private rental!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There really is no one else here.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We are the rulers of the kingdom[n]of dreams!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Is this lighting just for our sake as well?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's right.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It's beautiful...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: "It's not as beautiful as you..."

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's the kinda stuff couples say, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Almost anyone would fall for that line[n]in front of a sight like this!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Lady Ann, this view is not as beautiful as—

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, you guys're gettin' way too excited[n]about this stuff.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You say that like you're not tapping into[n]your inner child too, Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This is just 'cause Futaba kept naggin' me[n]to put 'em on!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I did not!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...You said somethin' like that!
Don't fight in those.
Fighting brings you closer.
Ryuji, you're the adult.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What was that!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's a good way of putting it. I wonder[n]if that has to do with where we are.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well yeah, but...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Whoa, look at you being all obedient![n]Is the Destinyland charm rubbing off[n]on you?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: My, this is so heartwarming!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Honestly, I would've liked to see[n]the parade as well.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But given how sudden the request was,[n]they couldn't get enough staff together[n]to do it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Perhaps that will have to wait until[n]next time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Either way, this party's totally the[n]best one so far! It's freakin' amazing!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm glad to see you're enjoying it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Be careful, Haru. You've shown these[n]guys what luxury means.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This'll really raise the bar for our next[n]celebration party.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You're already talking about our next[n]party? Don't you think that's somewhat[n]premature?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Still... How do I put this?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I met Mona-chan, I got to know you[n]all... Isn't everything going a little[n]too perfectly?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's actually a bit frightening...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You worry too much.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...I must just be overly cautious[n]because of my circumstances up[n]till recently.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm sorry for bringing it up.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, isn't it almost time? You know,[n]for the press conference.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ooh, perfect timin'!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Father...

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Thank you all for taking time out of[n]your busy schedules to gather here.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Today, I'd like to elaborate upon the[n]whole truth behind my company's[n]labor situation.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: How my employees were forced to work[n]under severe conditions, how... lax we[n]were with sanitation...

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: And how my corporation acted as a[n]whole to... cover up every facet of this[n]scandal.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: For all of this, I wholeheartedly[n]apologize.

entries.speaker: Calm Journalist
entries.en: So are you saying all of this was done[n]under your orders?

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: I... am solely responsible...

entries.speaker: Calm Journalist
entries.en: We heard that dozens of your[n]employees were forced to resign[n]due to mysterious illness.

entries.speaker: Calm Journalist
entries.en: Furthermore, these happened to be[n]officials who stood against your[n]proposal for overseas expansion.

entries.speaker: Calm Journalist
entries.en: The same thing also happened to[n]executives at competing companies[n]who were looking to expand abroad.

entries.speaker: Calm Journalist
entries.en: Is all of this true?

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Yes.

entries.speaker: Calm Journalist
entries.en: Was it all coincidence?

entries.speaker: Calm Journalist
entries.en: We'd like some answers.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: About that... I have a critical piece of[n]information to announce here today.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Here it comes.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okumura's going to say who's really[n]behind the mental shutdowns.
